description: Figure 6(a) is a pie chart titled “Video type distribution,” illustrating the proportional breakdown of 14 different video categories within the benchmark dataset. The largest segment, colored orange, represents “People Blogs” at 17.2%. The second largest, a green segment, is “Howto Style” at 9.7%. “Entertainment,” shown in purple, accounts for 13.9%. Other notable categories include “Education” (red, 8.7%), “Sports” (pink, 7.7%), “Gaming” (gray, 6.4%), “Travel Events” (yellow, 4.6%), “Comedy” (light blue, 6.4%), “Science Technology” (dark blue, 6.4%), “News Politics” (green, 4.3%), “Pets Animals” (light green, 3.9%), “Autos Vehicles” (red, 4.8%), “Music” (purple, 2.3%), and “Film Animation” (brown, 4.6%). Each slice is labeled with its category name and percentage, and the chart is presented without a legend or exploded slices, with segments arranged in a roughly descending order by size.
